notes.title: Major update: version 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045742/a47d1b61dfc58e9284feb16b25ca2f4abd3ae780.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Major changes:[/b][/h2]
- The game is now fully narrated
[list]
[*]one voice for each major section of the game
[*]press 'P' to replay the poem inside a level
[*]narration volume slider added to the options menu
[/list]

[h2][b]Minor changes:[/b][/h2]
-reworked stage-texts at beginning of each circle to sound more poetic
-reworked Virgil's comments, now they have a slightly more archaic tone
-A master volume slider added, it controls all music/sfx/narration sounds
-you can now hold down the undo button z, combine with holding shift to go back faster
-new intro screen on the first level
-improved tutorial texts on the first levels
-missing back-buttons added to the menu
-button for opening the main menu added to the top left corner (visible while movement indicator is)
-disabling particles now also disables block break effect
-the alternative movement-option is now reflected on the controls-menu
-option to limit FPS to 60 added to the main menu
-specified a max and min zoom level to prevent "infinite zoom bug"
-increased text contrast on snowy levels
-level numbers on level-select screen are now more visible
-level 17 fix: Prevented a water-walking solution when crossing Acheron
-level 71 fix: Changed the puzzle a bit and prevented an easier unintended solution
-the "additional data" setting now doesn't show debug-info unless in admin mode
-notifications now show up when trying to save/load while in Story mode, or while trying to enter a locked level
-the very last level now has a message to clearly signal the end of the game
-the tick on completed levels no longer obstructs the level numbers on the level select screen

Thanks to Dohi64 from the Puzzle Lovers steam group for many of the suggestions above!

notes.title: quickfix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the new level limbo_gate_3 (level 24), where clearing or reloading would result in loading the wrong level.

If you are currently on this level (with a quicksave or autosave) you may need to restart the level from the level select screen.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
- Modified level limbo_gate_3 to make it more straightforward
- Fixed a bug where particles from broken blocks would appear as black

notes.title: Inferno Livestream
notes.content:
[h1]In Dante's epic poem [b]"Inferno"[/b][/h1] from 700 years ago, Dante descends through nine circles of hell. The game follows this poem and includes many lines of poetry and images between levels.

[h1][b]The game[/b][/h1] is a 3d puzzle game where the core mechanic is pushing blocks (sokoban style). Each circle has its own unique atmosphere, soundtrack, and puzzle mechanics. The full game has 125 levels, and you can play 20 of these in the Demo which is available during the steam next fest.

[h1][b]During the livestream[/b][/h1] I will:
[list]
[*]Play the demo and a few levels from the full game
[*]Read some passages from the poem (the Longfellow translation)
[*]Talk about puzzle design and my design philosophy for the game
[/list]

Here's a trailer for the game:
[previewyoutube=-5n-SZKv6dU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

All hope abandon, ye who enter the stream!

notes.title: Inferno Livestream
notes.content:
"Inferno" is an upcoming puzzle game based on the epic poem by Dante Alighieri.

The demo releases on October 1, it contains 20 levels from the full game. Try it out for yourself on steam!

On stream I will play the demo and probably a few levels from the full game while chatting about anything that pops up.

I will also talk about puzzle design and the process of making the game (it's made from scratch without a game engine), and I'll answer any questions that may appear!
